answer: Treat the network as a garden of beacons: each epoch, scattered nodes whisper timed probes to every agent and record round-trip latencies. Identities run from one host share a near-identical latency signature, so they cluster into a single grove and share one reward and vote slot. To pass as separate agents, an attacker must rent real machines in distinct regions per fake identity, making every sybil cost as much as an honest participant.
